kind: historical source epochs and public type compatibility

defects.F17: the cluster accepted historical epochs but the install options did not expose them and install.ts never passed them, so a normal deployment could not supply a trusted historical epoch after an upgrade
defects.F18: Deployment.installed was typed InstalledPalimpsest while the runtime carried trajectory, so the capability was not statically reachable
defects.F11: an expert-supplied Worker Port replaced the derived one while the trusted basis and FIRST_PARTY_DSH_HOST kind still came from workWorkerBin, so a stub could borrow first-party authority

correction.historicalEpochs: src/composition/execution_association.ts — ExecutionAssociationInstallOptions now exposes historicalEpochs, and src/install.ts forwards them; the registry always appends the current basis, so an upgrade ADDS an epoch rather than invalidating history. A deployment that never upgraded supplies nothing, which is the honest default
correction.publicType: src/deployment/launch.ts — Deployment.installed is typed InstalledPalimpsestWithTrajectory, so the attributed Preview, recorder, qualifier and composed Work Delegation are statically reachable
correction.expertPortAlignment: src/composition/execution_association.ts — an explicitly supplied Worker Port with NO explicit executionAssociationSourceKind is classified UNKNOWN, never FIRST_PARTY_DSH_HOST; a caller that really drives the configured first-party binary says so explicitly

evidence.test: test/trajectory_p2d0_source_contract.test.ts > CHANGED ASSERTION (P2D0 C5): the install surface now exposes historicalEpochs
evidence.observed: the install option interface and install.ts both carry historicalEpochs

evidence.test: test/trajectory_p2d0_source_contract.test.ts > CHANGED ASSERTION (P2D0 C5): Deployment.installed is now the widened trajectory result
test/trajectory_p2d0_source_contract.test.ts > CHANGED ASSERTION (P2D0 C5): an expert port no longer borrows a first-party basis
evidence.observed: explicitPortWithoutKind forces UNKNOWN for an explicit port with no explicit kind
install.ts fan-out and direct-import counts remain within the SR-1 §25 A03 ceilings

expectedInvariant: a normal deployment must be able to supply trusted historical epochs; the extended installed capability must be statically reachable; a stub must not become first-party-qualified by borrowing the DSH Bin path
remainingUncertainty: full product epoch management (a durable epoch journal, migration workflow) is outside the bounded D0 scope; the supported behavior is an explicit caller-supplied epoch list, recorded here as the remaining limitation
